converseStream.description: One connection = one conversation: history lives in server memory for the socket's lifetime. Frames are JSON text; unknown fields are ignored, an unknown message type gets a non-fatal `error`. The first frame must be `initializeConnection`, within 10 s of connecting. Application close codes: 4400 protocol violation, 4401 authentication failed, 4408 timeout (init deadline or 300 s idle), 4429 reserved for rate limiting, 4503 key verification temporarily unavailable (retry with the same key; not an auth failure).

externalDocs.description: Streaming conversations — buffering, voice pinning, cancellation, billing.

converseStream.title: Conversation stream

addTurn.summary:
Adds a completed turn (transcript and audio) to the history without generating anything.
Reference audio added for a speaker pins how that speaker sounds in every later generation.
addTurn.title: addTurn

cancelResponse.name: cancelResponse

response_id.description: Only cancel this response; omit to cancel whatever is in flight.
response_id.title: Response Id

cancelResponse.summary:
Aborts the in-flight response. Idempotent — cancelling when nothing is generating (or naming
an already-finished response) is silently ignored.
cancelResponse.title: cancelResponse

error.name: error

fatal.description: True when the connection is about to close.
fatal.title: Fatal

response_id.description: Present when the error belongs to a specific generation.
response_id.title: Response Id

error.summary:
Any error, fatal or not. Non-fatal errors reject exactly one client message and change no
state; fatal errors are followed by a close.
error.title: error

initializeConnection.name: initializeConnection

api_key.description: Your API key — auth rides this first message because the browser WebSocket API cannot set headers.
api_key.title: Api Key

model.description: Public model id (see GET /v1/models). Omit/null for the default model.
model.title: Model

initializeConnection.summary:
Authenticates the session; must be the first frame, within 10 s of connecting. An invalid or
missing `api_key` gets a fatal `error` and close code 4401; if key verification is temporarily
unavailable the close code is 4503 — retry with the same key.
initializeConnection.title: initializeConnection

responseAudio.name: responseAudio

pcm_b64.description: Base64 raw PCM (`pcm_s16le`, mono, the session's sample rate) — headerless, unlike `addTurn` input.
pcm_b64.title: Pcm B64

responseAudio.summary: One chunk of generated audio, in generation order.
responseAudio.title: responseAudio

responseCreated.name: responseCreated

response_id.description: Id of this generation (`resp_…`); echoed on every related frame.
response_id.title: Response Id

speaker_id.description: The speaker whose turn is being generated.
speaker_id.title: Speaker Id

responseCreated.summary: Generation for a flushed turn has started; `responseAudio` chunks follow.
responseCreated.title: responseCreated

responseDone.name: responseDone

text.description: The final generated text on completion; the flushed input text on cancel.
text.title: Text

responseDone.summary:
The response settled — `completed` (the turn, with its final text, is now history) or
`cancelled` (the turn was dropped; partial audio is never context). Every response pairs a
`responseCreated` with exactly one `responseDone`.
responseDone.title: responseDone

sendText.name: sendText

flush.description: True ends the turn: the buffered text becomes this speaker's next turn and generation begins.
flush.title: Flush

speaker_id.description: Required on the message that opens a turn; optional (must match) while the turn's buffer is open. Resets at flush.
speaker_id.title: Speaker Id

text.description: Appended to the buffer verbatim — no separators are inserted; you own spacing and punctuation.
text.title: Text

sendText.summary:
Streams text for a turn. Text accumulates in the pending turn buffer (capped at 8,000
characters per turn); `flush: true` ends the turn and starts generation.
sendText.title: sendText
